parameters.description:
Send an SMS notification to your own MessageBird destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-messagebird-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `msgbird://` URL from your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev; on the gateway channels it transforms the envelope directly into a MessageBird Messages API JSON body and posts it to rest.messagebird.com with no Apprise involved.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`apikey_secret`, `source_secret`); the free `gateway` channel delivers direct to the MessageBird Messages API (no Apprise); and the `gateway-plus` channel adds extra per-enrollment MessageBird SMS destinations, direct, at $0.001 per message.

((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}}

parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to MessageBird Messages API (no Apprise)
